## Analysis

The repeated 1.083299 in sol_0024 shows that parallel tempering with local toggles, swaps, paired moves, and nearby projection changes did not escape sol_0023. Thus the `q=56`, `n=277` basin is locally stable; merely increasing local mutation variety is unlikely to help. Projection and mask must still be co-optimized, but the next search needs coordinated structural moves affecting whole tensor slices. Small-set, interval, affine-copy, periodic-lift, and sparsification lineages remain inferior. The useful unexplored direction is large-neighborhood optimization of rows and columns while preserving the successful tensor representation and medium density.

## Next

Embed sol_0023 as the immediate atomic fallback, fix `q=56`, and run a 155-second alternating row/column destroy-repair search: remove one randomly chosen tensor row or column, then beam-search its replacement mask with width `64`, testing `256` stochastic bit patterns plus greedy single-cell refinements per repair. Use seed `5025`, retain `240<=n<=320`, accept improving repairs deterministically and non-improving repairs by annealing from `T=0.003` to `0.00005`, with exact final scoring before every checkpoint.
